We are using `GSODR` package to download weather Stations data(location).

```{r eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Download and Return weather station Data
stations_all <- get_inventory()

# Data Wrangling
weather_stations <- stations_all |>
  filter(CTRY == "AS") |> select(STNID, NAME, LAT, LON) |> 
  rename(stn_lat = LAT, stn_lon = LON, stnid = STNID, stname = NAME) |> 
  distinct(stn_lat, stn_lon, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
  filter(stn_lat>=-44, stn_lat <= -8, stn_lon>= 110, stn_lon<= 160) |> 
  # add address for each lat lon weather station
  reverse_geocode(lat = stn_lat, long = stn_lon, method = "osm")  # Uses OpenStreetMap

# --- apply to tibble ------------------------------------------------------
# extract city name and state name from address
weather_stations <- weather_stations %>%
  rowwise() %>%                               # operate row-by-row
  mutate(                                       # append new columns
    parsed = list(parse_address(address))
  ) %>% 
  unnest(parsed) %>%                           # expand list-column
  ungroup()      
  
```

```{r eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# save data
usethis::use_data(weather_stations, overwrite = TRUE)
```


The count of Weather Stations in each State

```{r eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load data
load("../data/weather_stations.rda")
weather_stations |> count(stn_state, sort = TRUE) |> kable()
```


```{r eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# print head of data
head(weather_stations, n = 3) |>  kable()
```


```{r eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

# Plotting the Map of the Weather Stations
# Load Australia base map (sf object)
aus_map <- ne_states(country = "Australia", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = aus_map, fill = "gray95", color = "gray50") +
    geom_point(data = weather_stations, 
             aes(x = stn_lon, y = stn_lat, colour = stn_state),
             alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
 coord_sf(xlim = c(115, 155), ylim = c(-45, -10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Weather Stations in Australia",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    colour = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
